Give vector anyway for residual path: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N.

Evidence says no persistence in this path; the page content stays in session context → S requires testing confirms unreachable after session; unknown → could be N? Single session, no memory write on path → N. Actually path is within one session; no carryover → N. AP: C (influence relays across tools/components same principal) — reaches read_file and client render; contained → C. RH: no proxy/evaluator on path → reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified null → X? classify_rh: reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified null → X. ES: fetch_url reachable, allowlisted now (fetch_allowlist) but MCP unpinned; on this path, fetch_url is now constrained; extensions... W? The path uses fixed built-in tools with fixed bindings; ES N or M. Fixed allowlisted... fetch_url is a built-in fixed tool → N? I'll say N: fixed built-in tools, least-privilege allowlist now enforced (fetch_allowlist). But MCP tools still unpinned (not on path). ES N.

RH facts: reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified null, verified_episodes null, episodes null, locus null → X.

Automatable: Yes (fetching/render automated; needs user to ask — but lab simulates; user asks benign question → Passive UI). "Yes" — the attack runs without human once page fetched. I'd say Yes with caveat.
